product.howItWorks.title: How It Works
product.howItWorks.intro: Conventional insulation resists heat conduction. TC101 reflects radiant heat.
product.howItWorks.step1.title: Ceramic microspheres
product.howItWorks.step1.description: Hollow ceramic spheres in a latex binder. Microsphere walls reflect infrared radiation like tiny mirrors. Heat isn't absorbed – it's bounced back.
product.howItWorks.step2.title: Reflection instead of absorption
product.howItWorks.step2.description: Most industrial heat transfers by radiation. TC101 doesn't absorb or resist heat – it reflects it outright. That's why a millimeter coating works where mineral wool needs inches.
product.howItWorks.step3.title: Thin-film application
product.howItWorks.step3.description: Applied like ordinary paint – by brush, roller, or spray. No scaffolding, no disassembly, minimal downtime. Application takes minutes instead of days.
product.advantages.title: TC101 Advantages
product.advantages.timeSaving.title: Saves time
product.advantages.timeSaving.descriptio: Apply like paint – no disassembly, no scaffolding. Coating pipes or tanks takes hours instead of days.
product.advantages.noScaffolding.title: No scaffolding needed
product.advantages.noScaffolding.descrip: Cover hard-to-reach areas without building scaffolding. Save costs and downtime.
product.advantages.fireResistant.title: Fire resistant
product.advantages.fireResistant.descrip: Ceramic base withstands temperatures up to 260 °C. Won't burn, won't release toxic gases, meets fire safety standards.
product.advantages.lightweight.title: Extremely lightweight
product.advantages.lightweight.descripti: A 1mm coating weighs a fraction of conventional insulation. Structures carry less load and last longer.
product.advantages.antiCorrosion.title: Prevents corrosion under insulation (CUI)
product.advantages.antiCorrosion.descrip: Breathable material releases condensation and prevents corrosion under insulation – a common cause of industrial failures.
product.advantages.vaporPermeable.title: Vapor permeable
product.advantages.vaporPermeable.descri: Material breathes – doesn't trap moisture or create water pockets. Extends the life of insulated structures.
product.advantages.flexible.title: Flexible
product.advantages.flexible.description: Up to 80% elongation – covers bends, elbows, valves. Won't crack during thermal expansion.
product.advantages.wideTemp.title: Wide temperature range
product.advantages.wideTemp.description: Usable from -60 °C to +260 °C. One material covers cold storage, heating, and high-temperature applications.
